{{Quote|Hear me out on this&hellip; my daughter runs a relief group called "Undercity Assistance." They bring food and supplies to the poor in the lower levels.|Fieler Dan|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Undercity Assistance''' was a relief group run by [[Fieler Dan's daughter]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. The group brought food and other supplies to the poor inhabitants of the planet's lower levels.
